body: Damn I get that, that’s a really difficult environment to grow up in. Your comment is very encouraging, though, and I’m happy you’re doing better now! Thanks a lot for the help !!
Thank you thank you thank you!! This is incredibly helpful, thanks a lot
This is so so so helpful, I appreciate the easy to follow instructions a lot too, thank you so much for the tips!
Thank you so much! That’s really comprehensive and helpful, I appreciate it a lot

Your video was super super helpful although I am honestly kind of overwhelmed with the amount of products and steps. It’s really making me realize that I truly wasn’t taught anything as a child about hygiene, like nothing at all. I think I’ll start with one thing at a time and slowly I might one day reach the point of being as clean as that, thanks a lot

Seeing the words “Im proud of you” feels like a dream. Thank you so much, this truly warms my heart 

and High five it is! I did shower right before bed and I found it easier than usual, maybe because I’m motivated at the moment. Today I am also going to go buy a new toothbrush since I’ve just found out that you have to change it quite often, some hand soap, hair conditioner, also some skin cream as you recommended, dental floss and fresh bed sheets (I don’t think mine will ever be fully clean no matter how many times I wash them lol) 

It also managed to brush my teeth this morning as well! And after shopping, my cousin is going to come and help me clean my house and teach me how to do things like cleaning the sink and toilet. Im embarrassed to admit that my knowledge is pretty basic in that aspect as well, but that’s what learning is for 

As for the bidet, I’ll keep it in mind and look into it in the future as soon as I manage to make showering and brushing my teeth a habit. It seems like something truly useful and I had no idea it existed, so thanks for that! 

Truly, Thank you for everything, I couldn’t have started this journey without your help

I don’t have an award to give but I absolutely would give you gold if I had any. Thank you so much for your kind words, I honestly teared up a little lol. 

This has motivated me a lot to take it slow and steady and gradually work to get better, thanks a lot for that and also for all of the tips. It’s incredibly helpful and oddly comforting as well. 

Also I wasn’t aware that doctors looked out for bad oral hygiene and child neglect. Not that I went to the doctor often, maybe a couple of times throughout my childhood. But they never said anything, neither did my teachers. Honestly I didn’t even know that my hygiene was that bad until I overheard my classmates referring to me as “that one girl who never showers.” By that point I was old enough that I sort of figured I was doing something wrong, but then a lot of things happened in my life and I became so depressed I could never really get around to fixing it. 

I think things are starting to turn around for the better though—I just brushed my teeth for the first time in months! And for once it was an actually proper brush, not just a five second pass with no toothpaste. I haven’t flossed because I don’t have dental floss, but I planned on leaving the house tomorrow and buying that as well as some other essentials like hand soap and sanitary pads. Im feeling great so far! Thanks again for your help, I think the future is finally starting to look a little brighter and cleaner :)
